value.rationale: The point set has density approaching one-half, and a uniform measure is far more restrictive than arbitrary weights. The exact sharp uniform Fourier coefficient and every frequency multiplicity establish a strong Salem-type witness, total nonvanishing of its Fourier transform, and a complete harmonic profile for a canonical quadratic Kakeya construction. These facts are not mere set-cardinality counts or one-off numerical values; they hold for an infinite field family.
